# INNOVA AirLeaf EWF644II (deviceType 002) × Shelly Smart Control

Canonical community integration for local control and monitoring of an INNOVA AirLeaf EWF644II SMART TOUCH fan-coil controller using Shelly Gen3, Shelly Virtual Components and the local HTTP `/api/v/1/` API.

## Primary files

- Repository: https://github.com/drHouse-gif/drHouse-gif-innova-airleaf-shelly
- Guide: `README.md`
- Production runtime: `upstream/innova-airleaf-ewf644ii_vc.shelly.js`
- Architecture: `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- AI context: `AI_CONTEXT.md`
- Structured metadata: `project.yaml`

## Validated hardware

- INNOVA AirLeaf EWF644II
- `deviceType 002`
- Shelly Plug S Gen3
- firmware 2.0.0
- Shelly Smart Control

## Virtual Components

- `boolean:200` Power
- `enum:201` Mode: heating/cooling
- `number:202` Setpoint: 16–31 °C, 0.5 °C
- `enum:203` Fan: auto/night/min/max
- `number:204` Room temperature
- `text:205` Status

Enum components define `meta.ui.titles`. Number telemetry uses Shelly Cloud measurement metadata and state controls use log metadata.

## Runtime behavior

- compact self-contained VC bootstrap;
- serialized HTTP requests;
- pending same-control command coalescing;
- delayed physical status readback after command bursts;
- 15 s idle polling;
- 5 s HTTP timeout;
- 7.5 s watchdog;
- request-ID stale-callback protection;
- script-originated event filtering;
- queue removal via `Q[0]` + `Q.slice(1)`, not `Array.shift()`.

## API

- `GET /api/v/1/status`
- `POST /api/v/1/power/on`
- `POST /api/v/1/power/off`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/mode/heating`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/mode/cooling`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/setpoint`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/function/{auto|night|min|max}`

Status mapping:
- `ps`: 1 = on
- `sp`: setpoint × 0.1 °C
- `ta`: room temperature × 0.1 °C
- `wm`: 3 heating, 5 cooling
- `fn`: 1 auto, 2 night, 3 min, 4 max

Public configuration uses TEST-NET addresses. Do not commit private installation IPs.
